structLayoutVerification.primaryRuntimeDto: No C# DTO, NativeArray, NativeMinHeap, SignalBus payload, or Vault row was introduced by SHINOBU_359. The validator emits JSON report records only.

SELF_AUDIT.scalabilityCurve: Offline static gates do not consume GlobalQualityWeight and do not alter gameplay truth. Scalability is continuous at CI depth: default asmdef DAG is the cheap pre-merge pass; binary schema, CSV profile, and OOP scans are opt-in deeper passes without changing runtime DTO layout, authority routes, or save identity.
SELF_AUDIT.hPhiVaultStatus: SHINOBU_359 owns no runtime memory. It reads files through mmap and writes Docs reports. Vault-backed C# editor tuning was rejected because this agent is Tools-only.
SELF_AUDIT.pointerAliasingDependencyGraph: No Burst jobs or NativeArrays are introduced. Offline ThreadPoolExecutor lanes are host-tool parallelism, not SystemDispatcher runtime jobs.
SELF_AUDIT.dearLie: Manual compile-wall review and Unity import probing are replaced with a static graph proof. Complexity is O(N+E) over asmdefs for cycles and boundary checks, plus optional O(F) mmap scans for C#/QA reports; no scene simulation, GameObject construction, Physics calls, or Unity compile is required.
